newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuadorean students clash with police over cuts.
newsitem.headline: Ecuadorean students clash with police over cuts.

text.p: Ecuadoran students clashed with police in several cities on Friday in protests against the economic austerity policies of President Abdala Bucaram.
Hundreds of youths shouted anti-government slogans and attacked police with stones and sticks near Quito's Central University. Police responded by spraying tear gas.
Demonstrations against Bucaram's policies also took place in the port city of Guayaquil and the town of Cuenca, 275 miles (440 km) south of Quito.
Students and teachers are fighting a decision by Bucaram to decree rises in electricity rates of 235 percent for homes, 77 percent for shops and 53 percent for industries.
Trade unions are considering a general strike for Feb. 5 to protest against the increases.
